hashes.hash_method: Read this JSON as a generic object, set hashes.supersession_hash to null, then compute repository datatruth.HashJSON (json.Marshal -> unmarshal to any -> normalizeJSON -> json.Marshal with sorted keys and HTML-escape -> SHA-256 lowercase hex).
hashes.md_document_hash_method: Markdown: normalize the unique line '> Document hash: `<value>`' to '> Document hash: `SELF_EXCLUDED`' then SHA-256 the whole file UTF-8 LF bytes. The MD value lives only in the .md file (one-directional), not here.
